title: Host evidence acceptance receipt
description: One receipt records one component x one host x one lifecycle stage. See docs/contributing-evidence.md and scripts/host_receipts.py, which implements these rules in stdlib code (no external JSON Schema library) and is kept in sync with this file by tests/test_host_receipts.py.

id.description: <host_id>--<component_id>--<stage>--<yyyymmdd>, optionally with a '-N' (N >= 2) generation suffix for a receipt recorded with 'record --supersedes' for the same host/component/stage/date

supersedes.description: id of the earlier receipt (same host/component/stage/date) this one supersedes, set by 'scripts/host_receipts.py record --supersedes'. The earlier receipt file is left untouched and its reviews are not inherited by this one.

second_physical_machine.description: false only on the catalog's authoring host

hardware_profile_ref.description: Optional string reference into adoption/hardware-profiles.json hosts[].id, owned by another unit

catalog_revision.description: Full commit SHA of the checkout used to record this receipt

recorded_by.description: Who ran scripts/host_receipts.py record; an independent review must come from a different identity

identity_sha256.description: Domain-separated sha256 of 'host-receipt-identity-v1:' + $CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID, or else the normalized --identity; never the raw value

component_id.description: A manifests/stack.json components[].id or a catalogs/landscape/*.json layers[].winners[].component_id. May legitimately contain '/' (for example 'affaan-m/ECC') or ':' (for example 'candidate:cli-cli'); scripts/host_receipts.py's receipt_filename_stem() percent-escapes each to a distinct, reversible filename token ('/' -> '%2F', ':' -> '%3A', and a literal '%' itself -> '%25' first) so the receipt stays a flat file under evidence/hosts/<host_id>/. This escaping applies only to the filename, never to this field or the 'id' field.

layer_refs.description: Optional, set by 'scripts/host_receipts.py record --layer-ref CATALOG/LAYER_ID' (repeatable): the catalogs/landscape/{foundation,us-equities}.json layers whose role the commands exercise. A receipt with layer_refs counts only for rows (winners and alternatives) in those layers; without them it binds to every layer its component_id wins and verifies an alternative only when that alternative's repository is catalogued in one layer (scripts/platform_status.py in_layer_scope). record requires it at stage use for a component catalogued in more than one layer.

expected_exit.description: Optional; when present, this exit code (not 0) is the coherent pass value for this command

qualified_models.description: Local model weights qualified on this host's runtime (for example vllm, mlx-lm, llama.cpp), recorded with scripts/host_receipts.py record --qualified-model. Optional; distinct from tool_versions, which is the runtime component's own version.

model_id.description: Model identifier, e.g. a Hugging Face repo id

revision.description: Pinned revision/commit of the model weights

runtime.description: Serving/inference runtime, e.g. vllm, mlx-lm, llama.cpp

bars.description: Short text summary of the qualification bars this model met (e.g. tool-call accuracy, task pass rate)

reviews.description: The recorder writes exactly one self entry; independent reviewers append theirs with scripts/host_receipts.py review

identity_sha256.description: Domain-separated sha256 of 'host-receipt-identity-v1:' + $CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID, or else the normalized --identity; never the raw value
